Name: Fruit Tree Xp
Author: CosmicKillsSouls
Description:
This mod makes it so that the player gains farming xp (default: 5) per fruit when harvesting fruit from a fruit tree.

The mod should work with all fruit trees, vanilla and modded, but if it doesn't, make a bug report, and I will look into it.




[size=5]Join my [url=https://discord.gg/vukxK9pqrT]discord server[/url] for more mods and to suggest mods for me to make.[/size]
